claim.claim-text: 1. A bone plate fixation system, comprising:
2. The bone plate fixation system of claim 1, wherein the elongate visualization window of said triangular-shaped head portion of said plate body is an elongate aperture extending therethrough.

3. The bone plate fixation system of claim 2, wherein the aperture length of said elongate aperture in said triangular-shaped head portion extends in a direction substantially parallel with said slot length of said elongate slot in said elongate shaft portion.

4. The bone plate fixation system of claim 2, wherein said elongate slot in said elongate shaft portion is centered along said longitudinal axis; and wherein said elongate aperture in said triangular-shaped head portion is laterally offset from said longitudinal axis.

5. The bone plate fixation system of claim 2, wherein said elongate slot in said elongate shaft portion has a slot width; and wherein said elongate aperture in said triangular- shaped head portion has an aperture width that is less than said slot width.

6. The bone plate fixation system of claim 1, wherein said elongate visualization window is centered along said longitudinal axis and has a shape that is substantially symmetrical relative to said longitudinal axis.
7. The bone plate fixation system of claim 1, wherein said elongate visualization window has a trapezoidal shape.

8. The bone plate fixation system of claim 1, wherein said elongate slot in said elongate shaft portion and said at least one fastener opening in said triangular-shaped head portion are each centered along said longitudinal axis.

9. The bone plate fixation system, of claim 1, wherein said first plurality of said bone screw openings in said triangular-shaped head portion are arranged substantially symmetrical relative to said longitudinal axis, and wherein said second plurality of said bone screw openings in said elongate shaft portion are each substantially centered along said longitudinal axis.

10. The bone plate fixation system of claim 1, wherein said first plurality of said bone screw openings in said triangular-shaped head portion are sized, shaped and configured substantially identical to said second plurality of said bone screw openings in said elongate shaft portion.
11. The bone plate fixation system of claim 1, wherein said elongate shaft portion of said plate body includes three or more of said bone screw openings.
12. The bone plate fixation, system of claim 1, wherein said triangular-shaped head portion has a convex distal end surface that is substantially centered relative to said longitudinal axis.
